sprint: BACKLOG.md Batch 1 -- Bugs E + D (Graphics image rotation reaches Studio's compiled Layer Pack + Add Experience button in Scene Stack sidebar)
task: Closes Batch 1 (Bugs E + D) of the 5-batch BACKLOG plan. Bug E: World Builder v2's Engine Adapter (tools/world-builder-v2/js/projectModel.js's _syncUniversalContent, line 1879) hardcoded rotation:0 for a plain uploaded Graphics image slot ('shapeKind ? ... : 0'), silently discarding the graphicRotation slider's persisted value before it ever reached the mirrored Scene Layer -- while the sibling Shape-kind case correctly wrote graphicRotation through. Fixed: read graphicRotation for any graphic slot, image or Shape alike (`isImage ? (props.imageRotation||0) : (props.graphicRotation||0)`). Confirmed via decisive Playwright end-to-end that Bug E's rotation genuinely reaches Studio's compiled Layer Pack (Creator Governing Rule #5, Publish Fidelity): mirrored Scene Layer's .rotation === 135 for an uploaded Graphics image (previously silently 0), Shape-kind regression rotation === 90 still holds, and packageData.layerPack's compiled decoration.rotation carries 135/90 through to the .vtheme package Studio consumes -- root Studio's already-correct _layerDrawDecorationImage renderer (fixed by an earlier 'Studio drops rotation on image-kind Decorations' sprint) receives the honoured rotation. Bug D: '+ Add Experience' button added to World Builder's Scene Stack sidebar (tools/world-builder-v2/js/worldBuilderApp.js _renderSceneStackTab, right after '+ Add a Place'), full 100%-width matching Place, .disabled === currentProjectReadOnly matching Place's exact Guardrails binding (Creator Governing Rule #2). Clicking opens the Nursery tab in Experience Home with the create form pre-open (experienceHomeZone='nursery', experienceCreateFormOpen=true), giving Theme Authors one-click access to new-Experience creation directly from where they compose their Scene. Verified 26/26 assertions via batch1_bug_e_d_verify.js: model-layer proof of the rotation fix, Shape-kind regression, Publish Fidelity (compiled decoration.rotation for both image and shape kinds via packageData.layerPack), Guardrails source-level binding check (both Place and Experience buttons bind .disabled = currentProjectReadOnly), UI flow (create button appears/enables/opens Nursery form/successfully creates a real Experience). Both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) PASS unchanged. Root Studio (js/, renderer/) is untouched -- Bug E's fix flows through Studio's already-correct rendering code via the newly-honoured compiled decoration.rotation field. Confined to tools/world-builder-v2/js/projectModel.js and tools/world-builder-v2/js/worldBuilderApp.js.
